_about: The modules the generic slot library can host (ROADMAP B714, ADR-410 r4, ADR-412). One entry per module, in slot order: the first is fx/1, the next fx/2 (SPEC-ENGINE MO-28 numbers slots from 1). Everything the rack knows about a module comes from here and the files it names: the sibling tree and its pin, the manifest inside it, the state-budget row, horde's interim law/mod overlay (tools/rack/law/), the build recipe that compiles its adapter (tools/rack/modules/), and the adapter's factory function. No module is named in code: tools/module_neutral_check.py reads this file and is red when one of these names, a manifest address or a legacy identifier appears as a token in the library, preview_plugin.cpp or bridge_core.*. A consumer picks which entries it links (tools/rack/CMakeLists.txt, horde_rack_registry): the default plug-in takes every entry whose test_only is false. The pins live beside this file (tools/rack/pins/), the library's own, and a consumer may name its own pin directory (HORDE_RACK_PIN_DIR: <key>.pin and foundations.pin there win). Paths are repo-relative; a tree's default is ~-relative and expanded at configure time, never a machine path. tree.untracked_ok keeps Weir's check what it was before B714 (git diff of the clean paths, untracked files allowed: Weir is header-only and an untracked header is never included by a tracked one); every other tree is checked with untracked files too.
